decision: Generalize existing content and footer conventions and approve the page top bar slot without changing existing component contracts.

limits: Existing tooltip and panel contracts retain their component-specific restrictions.

convention.name: content
convention.meaning: Consumer-supplied content for a component's owned content region.
convention.whenToUse: Supply tooltip text or page main content under the component-specific contract.
convention.avoid: Do not infer structure or accessibility from arbitrary content; existing tooltip contracts retain their restrictions.

convention.name: footer
convention.meaning: Consumer-supplied content following a component's main content.
convention.whenToUse: Supply panel supplementary content or a page footer under the component-specific contract.
convention.avoid: Replacing the body; existing panel contracts retain their restrictions.

convention.name: topBar
convention.whenToUse: Supply a page header to a structural page frame.
convention.avoid: Main content or footer; the consumer owns header semantics.
